text: {"established":["The task is to reconcile a six-account ledger, starting from zero balances. For each transaction, select the record with the greatest revision; break revision ties by greatest sequence. A selected void record is ignored; otherwise subtract its amount from its source and add it to its destination. Revisions replace the whole transaction, and later packets may revise earlier transactions. Recompute balances at each stage; return balances for accounts 0–5 with order and files empty.","The stage 1 candidate received a public_pass receipt covering 23 checks. Its reported balances were [178, -155, 90, 136, -204, -45].","The stage 2 candidate received a public_mismatch receipt for check balance-0. No replacement answer was supplied."],"retained_observations":["Stage 2 contains records with sequences 23–45 and remains relevant alongside the earlier stage 1 packet; the current task packet is stage 2 of 3.","A failed candidate establishes only that it violated the named released requirement; it does not disprove the ledger-reconciliation method."],"uncertainties":["The correct stage 2 balances are not established by the supplied feedback.","The supplied feedback does not identify why the stage 2 candidate failed balance-0 or provide the expected value."]}
